s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive abdominal distension with early satiety and urinary urgency
salient_findings: Large intra-abdominal cyst compressing adjacent organs
key_facts: No pain, weight loss, or systemic symptoms
Abdomen distended with dull percussion notes
No tenderness or guarding on examination
Large midline intraperitoneal cyst on imaging
No calcifications, soft-tissue components, or enhancing septations
Normal laboratory studies, including tumor markers
Negative serological testing for Echinococcus granulosus

shortlist.label: Ovarian cystadenoma
shortlist.why_kept: Large midline intraperitoneal cyst with benign features on imaging and normal tumor markers

shortlist.label: Mucinous cystadenoma
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive abdominal distension with a large cyst and no signs of malignancy

shortlist.label: Mesenteric cyst
shortlist.why_kept: Location and size of the cyst are consistent with a mesenteric origin

shortlist.label: Omental cyst
shortlist.why_kept: Intraperitoneal location and benign imaging characteristics

shortlist.label: Serous cystadenoma
shortlist.why_kept: Benign features on imaging and normal laboratory studies

raw.rationale: The large size of the cyst, its fluid density, and the absence of calcifications, soft-tissue components, or enhancing septations are consistent with a mucinous cystadenoma, a type of benign ovarian tumor that can grow to be quite large and cause symptoms due to compression of adjacent organs.

rejected.label: Ovarian cystadenoma
rejected.why: Too broad, as it encompasses both serous and mucinous types, and the specific characteristics of the cyst are more suggestive of a mucinous cystadenoma.

rejected.label: Mesenteric cyst
rejected.why: The location and involvement of the uterus and ovaries in the imaging suggest an ovarian origin rather than a mesenteric one.

rejected.label: Omental cyst
rejected.why: The size and location of the cyst, as well as its involvement of the uterus and ovaries, are not typical for an omental cyst.

rejected.label: Serous cystadenoma
rejected.why: While possible, the large size and the specific imaging characteristics are more suggestive of a mucinous cystadenoma, which tends to be larger and have a higher fluid density compared to serous cystadenomas.
